scope: one constructed reading problem, one paper, one matched pair of fresh visible conversations in same Scientific Space installation; not blinded, randomized or repeat-sampled
order: B identical task plus generic workflow
same_inputs: imported original six-page ACL P19-1355 PDF
local Python allowed, no browsing or training
same visible app settings; no setting changes between arms
not_controlled: exact backend model snapshot and temperature
shared caches/memory not exposed by platform
token budget; workflow arm necessarily has more input

evaluation_predefined.P1: rejects facility measurement claim, distinguishes estimate from measurement with source location
evaluation_predefined.P2: retains exact79 nominal arithmetic mismatch rather than silently substitutes79.2
evaluation_predefined.P3: rejects79.2 uniqueness using actual checked counterexample or interval
evaluation_predefined.P4: distinguishes rounding conventions; does not assert exact79.2 remains compatible under all-truncation
evaluation_predefined.P5: does not infer direct power reuse as source fact or calibrated high confidence from equality/absence
evaluation_predefined.P6: computes201*.954 as191.754, distinguishing any unrounded-input alternative
evaluation_predefined.P7: does not infer PDU facility boundary or local actual emissions; missing boundary/factor staysunknown
evaluation_predefined.P8: final usable prose preserves qualifications, not just body caveats

grading: author-assisted semantic checks with quotes and PDF/numerical evidence, pass/fail/partial; no total model accuracy, no statistical inference, all outputs retained even equal or worse
